column1: # wackerbarth1717 key: Saxon cipher "S1" of Wackerbarth's Vienna mission, March-June 1717 (Dresden, HStA 10026 Loc. 00713/01).
# CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffrée, 2026; Claude Opus 5.5 agents). Rebuilt from the interlinear decipherments of the time
# in the same volume (views 0017, 0057-0062, 0071-0072, 0080-0081, 0086-0088), by alignment of cipher groups on glosses.
# System: homophonic substitution of French letters in 1-2 digit numbers (e 2/10, i 9, o 16/22/33, t 28/52 ...), polygrams and a
# nomenclator in 3-digit numbers (154 Votre Excellence, 177 le Czar, 217 le roi d'Angleterre, 252 le roi de Prusse, 292 la Pologne ...; 187 le roi de Suède only in section B),
# 4-digit numbers 50xx (and others) taken for nulls. Not the Flemming key K0 of Loc. 00675/10.
# Columns: number, value, aligned occurrences, safety (sur = sure, probable, inféré = inferred), justification (French, as frozen).
# SECTION A = KEY-W1717c exactly as frozen (frozen/KEY-W1717c.tsv, SHA-256 3322ae87...c49c, frozen/KEY-W1717bc.sha256) BEFORE the
# measurement; the only key used for decryption.txt, a24_decryption.txt and the official reading counts. Values [in brackets] are
# nomenclator words. An empty value = null. The frozen file's header says "PRIVÉE": the working files were kept private until
# this publication; the images still are.
# Integration notes (12 Nov 2026; the frozen rows below are not edited): 103 = "les" (view 0088) also reads "le": a gloss of

# the time gives it (view 0080 L03, "deloger les russes" over 53 2 12 16 7 10 27 103 29 60 ...: 103 29 = les): take 103 = le / les. 20 = "ee" is wrong: b, by a gloss of the 1715 volume (K1715) and section B.
# The glosses of the 1715 volume (s15_key.tsv) also give 4 = x, 76 = st and 306 = Vienne, which key c lacks.
